changelog: Initial release: CPU temp, throttling, voltage, memory, disk, fan, overclock, power checks
summary: Raspberry Pi health monitor. Check CPU temperature, throttling status, voltage levels, memory/disk usage, fan RPM, overclock detection, and power issues. Use when monitoring Pi health, diagnosing thermal throttling, checking for under-voltage, or verifying system stability on any Raspberry Pi (Pi 3/4/5, arm64/armhf).
